name: HGSS Visual Overhaul
author: LucianoNeo
description: HGSS intro and overworld overhaul for Gen 1 and Gen 2. PLAYER SELECT controls matching Red, Ash, Ethan, Lyra, Kris, Kris V2, Leaf or Brendan walking, bicycle, fishing and battle-back assets. TRAINER ART includes the credited HGSS-compatible portrait set for Gen 1 and Gen 2, with non-canonical compatibility alternatives for every legacy Gen1 trainer class; Gen 2 battle Pokémon remain native.
